points.title: Walking
points.titleSub: (Thirty minutes outside before you open a screen)

body.text: No podcast and no music. Just the walk. Most of what you were stuck on at midnight has an answer by the time you get back.
It exists to check that the batch endpoint sends ten decks to TikTok in one call. Delete it when that is confirmed.
